doc: n5-look iteration 20 (r2_w4 top right: the flame is a hot yellow core under an orange body): the burning ground's fire loop (features/fx/art/fx_fire.png, quest 1's three-ink art: a vermilion body round a cream core) re-inked token by token by tools/art/ground_fire.py into the flame family's colours, written to the weapon FX colour folder as ground_fire.png. FightAreasArt draws it on the FX colour canvas while that canvas is attached; `--ground-fire=ink` = the before (the vermilion and cream loop under the item print). The ink outline and hatching stay ink. No blood red, no teal. knockout (take 2): an opaque yellow core hid the scorch cell, whose dark heart inside the ring of tongues was the before's read (the scorch draws on the colour canvas, so before it sat over the host's fire); the core (paper, paper_2) goes clear and the orange tongues take a flat hot yellow within hot_px of it. Drop knockout = take 1 (the yellow core).
